prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Input image 1: postcard paper/composition reference. Input image 2: supporting city scene/palette reference.
Tactile mid-century travel-poster screen print; flat layered shapes, fine risograph grain and soft paper fibres. Calm, elegant, original artwork in Travary's navy/teal/coral/sage/mustard/warm-cream family. Never photographic. No words, letters, numbers, pseudo-text, readable signs, logos, watermarks, flags, faces or copyrighted characters. Famous architecture sits within a balanced city view, not an oversized isolated object. Exclude real theme-park attractions, Hollywood sign, Space Needle, Cloud Gate and casino buildings.
City: London. Scene: Tower Bridge over the Thames, a red double-decker bus with no writing or route number, a black cab and Georgian terraces. Light: soft grey-gold late-afternoon light. Palette: navy, river teal, muted stone, red and warm cream.
All six assets form one matching set. The input city card is a supporting scene/style reference; do not copy its ticket layout.
One single upright vintage postcard, exactly 1122 × 1402 PNG, straight on, centred on true transparent background, thin deckled warm-cream edge about 2% of width and faint contact shadow. City scene fills inside edge. Main bridge, bus, cab and terraces in left and lower two-thirds. Keep upper-right quarter quiet open grey-teal sky; a separate luggage tag overlays it in the app. No tag, stamp, postmark, UI or writing in image.
